display.title: Challenge: The Ultimate Wither
display.subtitle: An optional Tier 4 fight in the Nether
description: The strongest Wither there is, and it only exists in the Nether.
Craft Corrupted Soul Sand (soul sand or soul soil + 3 Nether Stars;
the recipe opens at Tier 4). Build the Wither's T of soul sand in
the Nether with the Corrupted Soul Sand in the centre of the arms,
then set the three Wither Skeleton Skulls on top. Built anywhere
else, the corruption is refused and your blocks stay where they are.
It fights harder than any Wither: 3,000 health, heavy armour, a
storm of skulls, charges and minions.
§7It drops 5 Nether Stars (the 3 you spent come back, and 2 more,
§7as a plain Wither gives), 2 Netherite Upgrade templates and a
§7great deal of experience. Optional: no gate depends on it.
